caption: The drawing depicts a square textile or quilt design. In the central area, there are four large, identical floral motifs. Each motif consists of four red petal or leaf shapes with yellow outlines, arranged in a rotational symmetry around a central point, and connected by green, elongated leaves. The background behind the motifs is filled with grey, intricate, swirling patterns. Surrounding the central area is a thin border composed of alternating small triangles in red, yellow, and green. Outside this, a wide border features a repeating, curved feather-like grey pattern on a light grey background. In the lower left corner, "MARIAN CURTISS" is written, with "Size 42” x 42”" and "Scale 3" written in the lower right corner. The overall composition is symmetrical, with predominant colors being red, green, yellow, grey, and white.
title: Crib Coverlet
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
